subject: 元北方王府殿院模块（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: one standalone realistic Yuan northern-China map sprite. Original game reconstruction, not exact monument. Photoreal hand-made grey tile, buff earthen plaster, brown timber, stone; same restrained realistic detail density as Song map kit, no toy look. CRITICAL orthographic2:1 dimetric camera yaw45 pitch30; ground axes slopes+0.5/-0.5 precisely, all parallel edges remain parallel, verticals vertical, no perspective. Thin FLAT rectangular ground apron, visible LEFT/FRONT/RIGHT ground corners; no thick slab. Transparent RGBA background, whole object with 10% transparent margin, upper-left light and very short lower-right contact shadow. No text, lettering, people, animals, signs, flags, UI, watermark, modern objects, sky, scenery, checkerboard, Qing architecture, elaborate gold dragons. Subject: Yuan Dadu princely residence / palace MODULE20x16m. ONE broad main reception hall with single-eave HIP ROOF and deep porch, two short lateral galleries, sober reddish-brown columns, substantial structural bracket sets, rich but restrained muted blue-green/red beam decoration, dark grey roof tiles with a few subdued glazed ridge ornaments. Raised hall podium has only3 shallow stairs INSIDE the footprint; outer footprint is thin flat ground. Thick buff court boundary, small simple gate, open orderly forecourt, no gardens. Use north-China Song-Jin/Yuan timber heritage, do NOT copy Forbidden City or Qing golden roofs. Original game-adapted palace module, not actual Dadu palace reconstruction. Footprint20x16 (ratio1.25) with clear ground corners; +/-0.5 axes essential. Match reference material realism only.
notes: 王府以大屋面、红褐柱和克制青绿梁枋表达等级，不是大都宫殿实测复原；生成主殿为歇山式倾向，非提示词庑殿的严格实现；保留candidate。
